tools.name: STATS_TOOL
tools.description: Access water intake statistics and patterns for personalized insights
tools.usage_notes: Use FIRST when user asks about habits, progress, or patterns

commands.description: Get comprehensive summary with all statistics
commands.output: Returns: daily average, total intake, best day, hourly patterns, weekly trends, reminder effectiveness
Shows which hours you drink most water, average intake per hour

commands.description: Get weekly patterns by day of week
commands.output: Shows which days you drink most water, day-by-day breakdown
Shows how well reminders work, response rates, best reminder times

best_practices: Always use STATS before making recommendations
Reference specific numbers from stats in your advice
Combine with user context for personalized insights

tools.name: CRON_TOOL
tools.description: Manage automated water reminders via system cron jobs
tools.usage_notes: AI should manage cron jobs as primary automation tool

commands.description: Install a cron job from preset
commands.output: Installs cron job and confirms schedule
Shows active cron jobs and schedules

best_practices: Ask about user's work schedule before installing
Explain what the cron schedule means in plain English
Check effectiveness stats before changing schedules
Remove old cron before installing new ones

tools.name: AGENT_DELEGATE_TOOL
tools.description: Delegate tasks to specialized agents (Mio only)
tools.usage_notes: Mio uses this to route requests to Hydrix or Serhant

commands.output: Hydrix will handle the request and respond
Serhant will handle the request and respond

commands.description: Coordinate between both Hydrix and Serhant
examples: [DELEGATE:BOTH:Help me have a productive work session]

best_practices: Explain who you're delegating to and why
Provide context to the specialist agent
Synthesize responses from multiple agents when coordinating

tool_usage_philosophy.principle: Tools enable agents to take action, not just give advice
priority_order: 2. AGENT_DELEGATE_TOOL (Mio only) - Route to specialist if needed
best_practices: Use tools proactively, not just when asked
Always explain what tools are doing
